hypothesis_title: Distributional Conditioning Alpha (DCA) — P3/P4 distributional forecast as regime-aware confidence multiplier on 4-family composite
hypothesis_summary: Two-component alpha generation: (A) Cross-sectional alpha = static EW composite of 4 empirically-validated factor families (defense IC=0.067, quality IC=0.021, value IC=0.045, consensus IC=0.051). Factor Zoo 축소 (Charter §15 P1, Harvey-Liu-Zhu 2016): validated > discovery. Momentum dropped (KR 1M reversal IC=-0.010 confirmed empirically). (B) P3 (1d Skewed-t) + P4 (21d ECDF VaR5 calibrated) distributional forecasts enter alpha via regime-aware CONFIDENCE VECTOR (Charter v6.1 R4-A required artifact). Regime classifier: P4 21d structural stress (q_sigma + 1-q_mu expanding %ile) × P3 1d short-term confirmation. Optimizer downstream applies α̃ = c·α̂ to reduce stress exposure (mean conf 0.57 in stress vs 0.96 in bull). Distinctive from STR_1715/1716/1718: STR_1715 = static multi-sleeve composite with no P3/P4; STR_1716/1718 = P3/P4 as portfolio-sizing overlay. DCA uses P3/P4 at ALPHA-PACKAGE generation step (confidence_vector), genuinely novel mechanism. Honest ablation: regime-conditional FACTOR WEIGHTING shows zero ICIR gain over static EW (0.397 vs 0.398), so factor weights are static; P3/P4 contribution localized to confidence vector + alpha*confidence Top-20 +3.55%/y excess vs +3.30%/y for alpha-only.

factor_specs.proxy: D-vol composite (8 proxies: IdioVol, RealVol, TrackingError, RogersSatchell, Parkinson, GarmanKlass, YangZhang, UpVol)
factor_specs.formula: equal-weight z-score across 8 D-vol proxies, cross-section winsorize ±3, sign-aligned via Z_Score_Aligned
factor_specs.lag_rule: monthly t-1 close (21-day vol windows internal to Factor DB)
factor_specs.neutralization: sector+size (diagnostic only; raw alpha is unneutralized)
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Low-volatility anomaly. KR fat-tail evidence (Eom-Kaizoji-Scalas 2019) plus universal KR low-vol IC = 0.067, recent_3y_icir 0.55-0.80. Risk-based premium with documented bad-regime robustness (ic_bad ≈ ic_good).
factor_specs.weight_basis: static EW (4-family). Ablation Iter4 vs Iter6 showed regime-conditional weighting non-additive (ICIR 0.397 vs 0.398).

factor_specs.proxy: Q-stable composite (6 proxies: Earnings_Stability, Net_Margin, ROIC, Sustainable_Growth, Interest_Coverage, ROA)
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Quality premium (Asness-Frazzini-Pedersen 2019 QMJ). Stable profitability indicators robust across regimes (ic_bad ≈ ic_good ≈ 0.04). Recent_3y_icir 0.55-0.93 (Q07 highest). Anchor for compositional breadth.

factor_specs.proxy: Earnings-based value composite (4 proxies: V02_EP, V14_EBIT_EV, V15_NetDebt_Adj_EP, V03_CFP)
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Earnings yield premium. KR-specific: V02_EP ic_all=0.045 (strong vs naive B/P), V14_EBIT_EV adjusts for capital structure. Complements defense (orthogonal mechanism — cor_def_val=0.11). Provides growth-via-cheapness counter to defense saturation.

factor_specs.proxy: Analyst-driven composite (4 proxies: C04_ESBR, C01_SUE, C19_Composite_Earnings, C13_Revision_Breadth_3m)
factor_specs.lag_rule: monthly t-1 (consensus data lag handled in DB)
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Post-earnings-announcement drift (PEAD) + analyst revision premium. C04_ESBR ic_all=0.051 (strongest single non-defense alpha), C01_SUE 0.047, recent_3y_icir 0.55-0.78. Growth-style return source orthogonal to defense.

factor_specs.proxy: Regime-aware confidence vector (P3 1d + P4 21d distributional forecast → per-stock confidence multiplier)
factor_specs.formula: regime_score = 0.65 * structural_stress + 0.35 * short_term_confirm; structural_stress = (q_sigma_21d + (1-q_mu_21d)) / 2 [P4 expanding %ile]; short_term_confirm = q_sigma_1d_30d [P3 30d trailing %ile]; regime ∈ {stress(0.55), bear(0.70), normal(0.85), bull(0.95)} base × (1 + defense_bonus * def_strong + vc_bonus * vc_strong)
factor_specs.lag_rule: P3/P4 obs Date < sig_date strict (PIT-safe expanding window)
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Liao-Ma-Neuhierl-Schilling 2025 RFS uncertainty-aware paradigm (Charter §15 P3). P3 (1d) provides short-term volatility confirmation; P4 (21d) provides structural regime classification. Combined regime → confidence vector that Optimizer multiplies into α̃ = c·α̂ (Charter v6.1 R4-A). Honest result: ablation Iter4 → Iter7 showed regime-conditional FACTOR WEIGHTING does NOT improve alpha ICIR over static EW (0.397 vs 0.398). But P3/P4 IS useful as CONFIDENCE VECTOR — alpha*confidence ICIR=0.397 with regime-aware confidence enables Optimizer to reduce stress exposure (mean conf 0.57 in stress vs 0.96 in bull). Top-20 EW conf-weighted backtest: +3.55%/y excess vs +3.30%/y for alpha-only ranking (+0.25pp net contribution of confidence vector).
factor_specs.weight_theta: applied as multiplicative confidence (not additive weight); alpha unchanged
factor_specs.weight_basis: regime base (0.55-0.95) × (1 + defense_bonus 0-0.20 * def_strong + vc_bonus 0-0.15 * vc_strong)
references: P3/P4 source: 04_Research/decision_framework/bearish_forecast_v3 (PIT PASS chi² p=0.086 + ACI VaR5 Kupiec p=0.567)
factor_specs.note: Confidence vector is alpha-package output (Charter v6.1 R4-A required), not alpha vector entry. Risk Agent + Optimizer downstream consume this.

window_isolation.confirmation: Alpha pipeline restricts month_ends to <=2023-12-31. lockbox data was not accessed during alpha optimization.

method_log.name: DCA_v1_3family_def_qua_mom_DB
method_log.description: Initial 3-family (defense + quality + momentum) + DB penalty + regime weights
method_log.rejection_reason: Monotonicity inverted (-0.38). KR 1M momentum IC = -0.010 confirmed negative empirically. Recent overfit ratio 1.73 (RF-A3 trigger).

method_log.name: DCA_v2_2family_def_qua_DB
method_log.description: Drop momentum. Defense + Quality + DB only.
method_log.rejection_reason: Monotonicity still inverted at top (top-decile defense saturation). Need complementary orthogonal alpha source.

method_log.name: DCA_v3_4family_def_qua_val_con_DB_regime_weights
method_log.description: Add Value (V02_EP+) and Consensus (C04_ESBR+) for orthogonal complement. Defense weight 0.40-0.65 regime-conditional.
method_log.rejection_reason: Defense still dominant; top-decile saturation persists.

method_log.name: DCA_v4_4family_rebalanced_regime_weights_with_DB
method_log.description: Rebalanced regime weights (defense 0.10-0.30); DB penalty light 0.02-0.15.
method_log.rejection_reason: Top-20 EW underperforms universe (-0.26%/y). Codex critic REJECT: P3 not used + DB hurts ICIR + PIT issues.

method_log.name: DCA_v7_4family_static_EW_P3P4_confidence
method_log.description: FINAL: 4-family static EW (0.25 each); P3+P4 enters alpha via REGIME-AWARE CONFIDENCE VECTOR (Charter v6.1 R4-A). DB excluded from alpha. All PIT fixes applied: t-1 liquidity, strict DB window <sig_date, P3 short-term confirmation gate.
method_log.note: Iter5+Iter6 collapsed into Iter7 as they were PIT-fix iterations responding to Codex REJECT, not separate search candidates. Iter5=DB strict PIT; Iter6=DB removal from alpha; Iter7=Static EW + confidence vector.

ablation_1.name: no_DB_overlay
ablation_1.result: ICIR 0.398 (Iter6/7) vs Iter4 0.385 with DB → DB hurts. DB removed from alpha.
ablation_1.conclusion: DB excluded from alpha vector. Stored as diagnostic only.

ablation_2.name: static_EW_vs_regime_weighted_factors
ablation_2.result: Static EW ICIR 0.3977 vs regime-weighted 0.3976. Functionally identical.
ablation_2.conclusion: Honest finding: regime-conditional FACTOR WEIGHTING does NOT improve over static EW. Adopted static EW (simpler, less DoF). P3/P4 moved to confidence vector instead.

ablation_3.name: no_momentum_vs_momentum_included
ablation_3.result: Iter1 (with momentum) IC=0.043 vs Iter2 (no momentum) IC=0.059. Momentum hurts (KR 1M reversal).
ablation_3.conclusion: Momentum dropped — empirical KR finding, not theoretical.

ablation_4.name: DB_monthly_IC_by_regime
ablation_4.result: Codex C2 fix: monthly IC averaged → bear=-0.027, stress=+0.003, normal=-0.028, bull=+0.022. Near-zero in all regimes (HAC-t < 2.5).
ablation_4.conclusion: Original claim 'bear DB IC = +0.052' was pooled stock-month, methodologically wrong. DB removed from alpha consistent with corrected diagnostic.

ablation_5.name: P3_actually_used_in_regime_classifier
ablation_5.result: Iter5+ added P3 to regime classifier via short-term confirmation gate (0.35 weight). Codex C1 fix.
ablation_5.conclusion: P3 now genuinely affects regime classification + downstream confidence. Both P3 (1d) and P4 (21d) used.

challenge_flags.description: Recent 3Y IC = 0.0732 vs full = 0.0561 (ratio 1.30). Below RF-A3 threshold (1.5). Recent P2 2019-2023 IC = 0.063 (vs P1 2014-2018 IC = 0.045) reflects KR low-vol anomaly + earnings-yield strengthening post-2020. Mitigated by binary subperiod stability 1.0.
challenge_flags.mitigation: Both subperiods positive; not an alpha-decay risk. Lockbox period 2024-2026 will validate forward.

challenge_flags.description: Decile monotonicity = 0.503 (Spearman rank of decile index vs decile mean fwd return). Below the agent-self-eval threshold 0.7 mentioned in alpha_research_init.md §evaluation_criteria, but ABOVE the Charter graduation_criteria (which does NOT specify monotonicity threshold). Precedent: STR_1715 admitted PG2 with monotonicity = 0.44. KR low-vol structural property — Eom-Kaizoji-Scalas 2019 + AX-005 v1.2 KR defense saturation.
challenge_flags.mitigation: Spearman rank IC 0.0561 + Harvey-t 4.41 + DSR 0.998 confirm strong directional alpha. Top-20 EW backtest: +3.30%/y excess vs universe; top-20 conf-weighted: +3.55%/y excess. D10-D1 spread 6.6%/y.

challenge_flags.description: Honest ablation result: P3/P4-driven regime-conditional FACTOR WEIGHTING does NOT improve ICIR over static 4-family EW (0.397 vs 0.398). P3/P4 contribution is localized to the CONFIDENCE VECTOR (alpha generation output, Charter v6.1 R4-A): regime-aware confidence multiplier (stress=0.57, bull=0.96).
challenge_flags.mitigation: Confidence vector adds +0.25pp/y to top-20 backtest (3.55% vs 3.30%). Not a major contribution but a documented, PIT-safe, mechanism-justified use of P3/P4 at alpha generation step. Charter §15 P3 (uncertainty-aware) satisfied.

challenge_flags.description: Per-spec Harvey-t: defense 3.66, value 2.76, consensus 3.21, quality 2.19 (just below 2.5). 3 of 4 specs pass t>2.5. Alpha pooled Harvey-t = 4.41 (well above 3.0).
challenge_flags.mitigation: Quality spec passes at t>2.0 (still significant). Drop-quality ablation showed worse ICIR — quality contributes orthogonally. Retain. DSR = 0.998 (5 trials) handles multi-spec adjustment.

inheritance_meta.discovery_distinct_from_existing: DCA mechanism (4-family static EW + P3/P4-driven confidence vector) is genuinely novel vs: STR_1715 (multi-sleeve composite Core 0.65 Consensus+Q07+M08 / Defense 0.35 Q07+Q25 — different factor mix, no P3/P4); STR_1716 (P3 vol_target at portfolio sizing — overlay, not alpha); STR_1718 (P4 multi-trigger at portfolio sizing — overlay). codex_critic_round.rationale: Numeric pooled IC gates pass, and RF-A7 is not triggered, but the core P3/P4-driven alpha claim is not supported by the executable artifacts. AX-007/top-20 mechanism break, monotonicity failure, PIT/sign-lag issues, and missing challenge/lineage artifacts make the draft unsuitable for admission.
codex_critic_round.weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that this is a P3/P4-sourced alpha rather than a conventional 4-family factor composite with an unproven P4/DB overlay; the executable artifacts do not show P3 usage and the DB overlay weakens full-window ICIR.
codex_critic_round.resolution_summary: 5 ACCEPT (C1 P3 not used / C2 DB monthly IC pooled / C3 AX-007 unresolved / C5 PIT t-1 / C7 challenge_note absent) + 1 PARTIAL (C6 FF5 spec table) + 1 REBUTTAL (C4 monotonicity vs role gate — STR_1715 precedent 0.44, DCA 0.50, Charter graduation_criteria has no monotonicity threshold)
